_comment: Bad events: dangers, hazards, and punishing encounters. ~35% of new pool. Health losses range -8 to -22.

events.title: Hidden Wasp Nest
events.description: The trail narrows between two mossy logs. As you brush past, the air fills instantly with an angry droning. A large grey papery mass hangs just beneath the log to your right — you've already disturbed it.

cues.description: Grey papery mass under a log — a wasp nest
Sudden angry droning rising in pitch
Wasps beginning to pour from the nest opening

choices.text: Run immediately, don't look back

outcome.description: You sprint hard and get distance fast. Still stung several times on your arms and neck before you clear the swarm. The pain fades to a dull burn.

memory_reward.title: Wasp Nest
memory_reward.description: Grey papery nest under a log. Disturbing it triggers instant mass attack. Running works but expect stings before you're clear.
hidden_traits: retreating through smoke can break a pursuit

cue_tags.description: grey papery mass under logs or in scrub
buzzing louder than normal near a spot

choices.text: Freeze and try to back away slowly

outcome.description: Wasps don't negotiate. The slow movement does nothing — the swarm reaches you before you're out of range. You take a punishing number of stings.

memory_reward.title: Wasp Attack
memory_reward.description: Wasps attack instantly when nest is disturbed. Freezing or moving slowly is useless — run immediately and put distance between you and the nest.

cue_tags.description: sudden angry high-pitched droning

events.title: Burning Skin
events.description: You push through a dense section of undergrowth. A few minutes later your forearms start to itch, then burn. The plants you brushed against had slightly waxy, notched leaves — you noticed but didn't think twice.

cues.description: Waxy, slightly notched leaves on low-growing plants
Faint oiliness on the leaf surface when touched

choices.text: Rinse with water from your supply immediately

outcome.description: Quick action limits the damage. The burning continues for a while but the rinsing dilutes the resin. A painful lesson, but manageable.

memory_reward.title: Toxic Contact Plant
memory_reward.description: Waxy notched leaves on low undergrowth — contact causes burning skin reaction. Rinse immediately to limit damage. Avoid plants with oily, waxy leaves in dense undergrowth.
hidden_traits: reaction worsens significantly in sunlight after contact

cue_tags.description: waxy, notched-edge leaves in dense undergrowth
slight oiliness when touching the leaf surface

choices.text: Ignore it and keep moving

outcome.description: The rash spreads quickly. By the time you stop, both arms are a swollen, weeping mess. You lose hours unable to move properly.

memory_reward.title: Toxic Contact Plant
memory_reward.description: Waxy notched-leaf plant in undergrowth. Contact causes severe reaction — worsens if untreated. Must rinse immediately.

cue_tags.description: waxy notched leaves in dense undergrowth

events.title: Crashing in the Brush
events.description: Something large is moving fast through the undergrowth to your left. Before you can react, a stocky black shape bursts onto the trail — a wild boar with small dark eyes. It stops, lowers its head, and snorts.

cues.description: Crashing in the undergrowth, moving fast
Stocky black animal, small eyes, lowered head
Strong musky animal scent, different from a bear

choices.text: Climb the nearest tree immediately

outcome.description: You scramble up before it commits to the charge. It circles below, snorting aggressively, then loses interest. Boars can't climb — high ground works.

memory_reward.title: Wild Boar
memory_reward.description: Stocky black animal, lowered head = charge incoming. Cannot climb. Getting off the ground immediately is the correct response.
hidden_traits: a sow with piglets is more dangerous than a lone boar

cue_tags.description: heavy crashing movement in dense brush
lowered head, snorting = charge warning

choices.text: Stand your ground and shout

outcome.description: It charges without hesitation. You take a glancing blow from its flank that sends you off the trail. Bruised and winded, you lie in the undergrowth as it disappears.

memory_reward.title: Wild Boar
memory_reward.description: Shouting at a charging boar does not deter it. Unlike a bear, it does not bluff. Must get off the ground — boars cannot climb.

cue_tags.description: lowered head before charge

events.title: Soft Ground at the Bank
events.description: The riverbank looks firm — pale sand, almost white. But when you step onto it, your foot sinks immediately and keeps sinking. Waterlogged sand. You're already knee-deep before you understand what's happening.

cues.description: Very pale, smooth sand at the river edge — no footprints, no vegetation
Ground vibrates slightly when you tap it — waterlogged

choices.text: Lean back, spread your weight, and drag yourself out slowly

outcome.description: Panic would bury you deeper. You force yourself to stay calm, lean back to redistribute your weight, and slowly drag each leg free. You emerge exhausted, soaked, and shaken.

memory_reward.title: Saturated Sand Trap
memory_reward.description: White smooth sand at riverbend with no tracks or vegetation = saturated and unstable. Do not step on it. If caught: lean back, spread weight, move slowly.
hidden_traits: saturated patches are more common after heavy rain

cue_tags.description: pale smooth sand with no footprints or plants
ground vibrates when tapped near riverbank

choices.text: Thrash and pull yourself out with force

outcome.description: Struggling drives you deeper. By the time you stop fighting, you're waist-deep and exhausted. It takes an agonizing half-hour to work yourself free.

memory_reward.title: Quicksand — Don't Struggle
memory_reward.description: Struggling in saturated sand makes it worse. Panic = sink deeper. Calm, slow spreading of weight is the only escape.

cue_tags.description: pale unmarked riverbank sand

events.title: Old Cooked Meat
events.description: At your campsite you find remnants of a previous fire and, wrapped in leaves nearby, what looks like cooked meat. It smells faintly off, but you're hungry and the outside looks undamaged.

cues.description: Faint sour smell from the wrapped meat — not obvious at first
Cooked meat wrapped in leaves, exterior undamaged
Small flies circling the leaf package

choices.text: It looks fine — eat it

outcome.description: Within an hour your stomach cramps violently. You lose the meal and more. The outside was deceptive — the meat had spoiled from the inside.

memory_reward.title: Spoiled Meat
memory_reward.description: Cooked meat left out in warm weather spoils quickly, inside-out. Outside appearance is unreliable. Trust your nose — even faint sourness means discard.

cue_tags.description: even faint sour or off smell from meat

choices.text: Smell it carefully — if there's any doubt, discard it

outcome.description: You bring it close and sniff properly. Yes — definitely sour. You discard it. Still hungry, but not sick.

memory_reward.title: Food Smell Test
memory_reward.description: Even faint sourness in cooked meat means it has spoiled. The smell test is more reliable than appearance. When in doubt, discard.

cue_tags.description: sour or off note in cooked meat

events.title: The Short Way Through
events.description: The main trail is washed out ahead. You can see a narrow gap through a dense thorn thicket — it would save an hour. But the thorns are long and the gap is tight.

cues.description: Dense thorn branches, long curved spines, barely passable gap
Tufts of animal fur caught on several thorns

choices.text: Push through quickly

outcome.description: The thorns tear at every exposed surface. By the time you're through, your arms, face, and legs are scored with long cuts. The hour saved cost you badly.

memory_reward.title: Thorn Thicket
memory_reward.description: Dense thorn brush is not a shortcut. The cuts are worse than they look mid-push. Go around — always.

cue_tags.description: fur caught on thorns — animals avoid this route

choices.text: Take the long way around

outcome.description: An hour lost on the detour. Nothing gained, but nothing damaged either.

events.title: Rising River
events.description: You need to cross. This morning the river was ankle-deep and calm. Now, after hours of distant rain, it's thigh-deep and brown, carrying broken branches. The crossing looks fast.

cues.description: Brown turbid water carrying debris — much higher than before
Loud rushing, much louder than a normal crossing would suggest
Earthy, muddy smell from the churned water

choices.text: Cross now — it can't get that deep that fast

outcome.description: Mid-crossing, a surge hits. You lose your footing and get swept twenty metres downstream before you drag yourself onto a bank, battered and soaked.

memory_reward.title: Flash Flood River
memory_reward.description: Brown water carrying debris = flash flood. Do not cross. The surge comes fast and without warning. Brown turbid water + loud rushing = stay back.
hidden_traits: rainfall upstream hours earlier causes flash floods with no local rain warning

cue_tags.description: brown turbid water, floating debris
roaring louder than expected river flow

choices.text: Wait for the water to drop before crossing

outcome.description: Two hours later the water clears and drops. You cross easily. The patience cost time, but watching the flood surge through confirmed the right call.

memory_reward.title: Flash Flood — Wait It Out
memory_reward.description: Brown turbid rivers after rain drop to safe levels within a few hours. Patience is the correct response. Never cross brown turbid water.

cue_tags.description: brown water with debris

events.title: Walking After Dark
events.description: You've been walking past nightfall. The trail is uneven and the moonlight is weak through the canopy. You can't see more than a few steps ahead. Every root and rock is a threat.

cues.description: Trail barely visible — weak filtered moonlight only
Ground uneven underfoot, roots and loose rocks

choices.text: Keep moving — you need to make distance

outcome.description: Your foot catches a root. You go down hard on a rocky section of trail — knee and palm taking the worst of it. Moving fast in darkness was the mistake.

memory_reward.title: Night Walking Hazard
memory_reward.description: Trails after dark on uneven ground with low visibility are high injury risk. Distance made at night often costs more in falls than it gains.

cue_tags.description: trail barely visible, canopy blocking moonlight

choices.text: Make camp now — walking blind isn't worth it

outcome.description: You stop and rest. In the morning the trail is clear and obvious. The distance you would have gained was not worth a broken ankle.

memory_reward.title: Stop Before Dark
memory_reward.description: Night travel on uneven trail = high fall risk. Stopping and resting beats the time saved by a bad injury. Make camp before visibility fails.

cue_tags.description: fading light, darkening trail

events.title: Still Shape in the Grass
events.description: You nearly step on it before you see it — a thick-bodied snake coiled on a sun-warmed flat rock at the edge of the trail. Banded pattern, triangular head. It hasn't moved.

cues.description: Thick-bodied banded snake coiled on a sun-warmed rock
Triangular, wide head — not arrow-shaped

choices.text: Freeze, then back away extremely slowly

outcome.description: The snake watches with flat, cold eyes. You give it five metres and it loses interest, slowly uncoiling. Snakes don't pursue — they only strike when cornered or stepped on.

memory_reward.title: Venomous Snake
memory_reward.description: Thick body + triangular head = venomous. Freeze and back away slowly. Snakes do not pursue. They strike only when cornered or touched.
hidden_traits: sun-warmed rocks are favoured basking spots — always scan before stepping

cue_tags.description: triangular wide head, banded or patterned body
coiled on sun-warmed flat rock

choices.text: Try to pin it or move it off the trail

outcome.description: The moment you reach forward it strikes — fast, precise, and without warning. The bite is on your hand. The next hours are miserable.

memory_reward.title: Snake Strike
memory_reward.description: Never reach toward or attempt to move a venomous snake. The strike is too fast to avoid at close range. Back away — they do not pursue.

cue_tags.description: triangular head = do not approach

events.title: Still Green Pool
events.description: A wide, still pool sits off the trail. The surface is coated with a faint green film. No current, no inflow visible. You're thirsty and it's the only water in an hour's walk.

cues.description: Still water with a faint green surface film
Faint algae and mud smell — slightly stale
No visible inflow or outflow — completely still pool

choices.text: Drink it — you're very thirsty

outcome.description: The smell should have been enough. Within hours you're doubled over with cramps and nausea. The algae bloom was well-established. You pay for it heavily.

memory_reward.title: Stagnant Algae Pool
memory_reward.description: Green surface film + no inflow + stale smell = contaminated. Never drink from still standing water with visible algae or film. Causes severe sickness.

cue_tags.description: green film on still water surface
stale, algae or sulphur smell

choices.text: Don't drink it — the green film is a warning sign

outcome.description: You go thirsty. Better that than what the water would have done.

memory_reward.title: Green Pool Warning
memory_reward.description: Green film on still water = algae contamination. Thirst is easier to manage than severe sickness. Never drink from still green water.

cue_tags.description: green surface film on still water

events.title: Widowmaker
events.description: You're resting under a large old oak. High above you, a thick dead branch hangs at an angle — partially broken, held only by a strip of bark. The wind picks up slightly.

cues.description: Large dead branch hanging at an angle overhead, bark hanging loose
Faint creaking from above when the wind moves

choices.text: Move away from under the branch — this is a classic widowmaker

outcome.description: Ten minutes later the branch falls with a thunderous crack exactly where you were sitting. The impact craters the ground. You watch from a safe distance, grateful.

memory_reward.title: Widowmaker Branch
memory_reward.description: Dead branches hanging at an angle in old trees are called widowmakers — they fall without warning in wind. Never rest directly under one.
hidden_traits: look up before resting under any large old tree

cue_tags.description: large dead branch at an angle, loose bark
creaking from overhead in wind

choices.text: Stay — it's probably been hanging there for years

outcome.description: A gust shakes the tree. The branch cracks and plunges. It clips you as it falls — a glancing blow but heavy enough to put you on the ground.

memory_reward.title: Widowmaker — Don't Wait
memory_reward.description: A hanging dead branch that has been there for years can fall at any time. The creak means it's close. Never wait it out.

cue_tags.description: dead branch at angle overhead

events.title: Eyes in the Dark
events.description: On a long stretch of road after nightfall you notice glints of reflected light in the treeline. Then another. Then several more. Low to the ground. Moving in parallel with you.

cues.description: Multiple reflected light points, low, in parallel movement in treeline
Soft padded movement — more than one animal
Faint musk on the air from your left

choices.text: Build a fire immediately — wolves fear fire

outcome.description: You stop and get a fire going fast. The eyes hold for a moment, then withdraw into the dark. The fire holds them at a distance through the night.

memory_reward.title: Wolf Pack at Night
memory_reward.description: Multiple reflected eye-glints in treeline = wolf pack tracking you. Fire deters them reliably. Stop moving and make fire immediately — don't try to outpace them.
hidden_traits: a lone wolf rarely approaches a fire — packs are bolder

cue_tags.description: multiple low eye-glints moving in parallel

choices.text: Run for it — you're close to camp

outcome.description: Running triggers the instinct. They close the gap instantly. You don't make camp. You make it, barely, but not without paying for the mistake.

memory_reward.title: Wolf Pack — Never Run
memory_reward.description: Running from a wolf pack triggers pursuit. They are faster. Do not run. Stop, make fire, make noise. Running is the worst possible response.

cue_tags.description: multiple low glints tracking you at night

events.title: Loose Ceiling
events.description: You've moved deeper into the cave to shelter. The rock above is fractured — you can see hairline cracks running across a large slab overhead. Small pieces of grit fall occasionally. The rock looks recent.

cues.description: Hairline cracks across a large ceiling slab
Small pieces of grit falling onto your shoulders
Fresh pale edges on the cracks — recent movement

choices.text: Get out of the cave immediately — those cracks are fresh

outcome.description: You exit quickly. Minutes later a deep crack and grinding sound — the slab shifts. Dust billows from the entrance. You were right to go.

memory_reward.title: Cave Rockfall Warning
memory_reward.description: Fresh pale edges on ceiling cracks = recent movement = imminent. Falling grit = it's already moving. Exit immediately — do not wait to confirm.
hidden_traits: vibration from footsteps can trigger unstable ceilings

cue_tags.description: cracks with pale fresh edges in cave ceiling
grit or dust falling from above

choices.text: Stay — caves always drop a bit of grit

outcome.description: The slab shifts with a deep groan and drops several inches before jamming against the wall. Fragments of rock hit you from all angles. You crawl out badly cut.

memory_reward.title: Cave Ceiling Collapse
memory_reward.description: Falling grit and fresh cracks in a cave ceiling are not minor signs. They mean the rock is already moving. Stay = get hit.

cue_tags.description: grit falling from cave ceiling

events.title: Cold River Crossing
events.description: A shallow-looking ford. But when you step in, the cold is a physical shock — far deeper and faster than it appeared. The stones are slick with algae. The far bank looks achievable but you're already shaking.

cues.description: Shockingly cold water — deeper and faster than it looked
Slick algae-covered stones underfoot
Water level at thigh-depth mid-crossing

choices.text: Push through to the far bank — you're already in

outcome.description: You make it but the cold has taken its toll. Shaking and numb, you drag yourself onto the bank. You need fire immediately. The crossing nearly cost you everything.

memory_reward.title: Cold River Crossing
memory_reward.description: Cold moving rivers are much colder than they look. The cold causes rapid loss of muscle control. If you must cross — move fast and have fire ready on the far bank.
hidden_traits: glacial melt rivers are cold year-round regardless of air temperature

cue_tags.description: shockingly cold water on entry

choices.text: Retreat and find a shallower ford

outcome.description: You back out before committing too deep. An hour upstream you find a knee-deep ford with visible bottom and no algae. The detour was absolutely worth it.

memory_reward.title: River Crossing Safety
memory_reward.description: Slick algae stones + cold shock + depth = wrong ford. Spend the time to find a better crossing. Visible bottom, knee-depth max, no algae.

cue_tags.description: algae on stones, no visible bottom
cold shock on initial entry

events.title: Nettles Across the Path
events.description: A dense patch of tall nettles has grown across the narrow trail. They're unmistakable — serrated oval leaves with fine hair-like stingers visible on the stem. The patch is about two metres wide.

cues.description: Tall serrated-leaf plants with fine white hair-like stingers on stems
The air feels slightly damp here — nettles thrive in moist hollows

choices.text: Push through bare-armed — it's only a patch

outcome.description: The contact is immediate and intense. Both arms erupt in white welts and burning within seconds. You're through in moments but the pain lasts for an hour and limits your movement.

memory_reward.title: Stinging Nettles
memory_reward.description: Serrated oval leaves with white hair-like stingers on stems. Contact = intense burn and welts. Cover skin or detour — no other options.
hidden_traits: young boiled nettle leaves are edible — the sting is destroyed by heat

cue_tags.description: serrated leaves with white hair-like stingers on stem

choices.text: Cover your arms and push through

outcome.description: The covered skin breaks through without incident. A few minor stings on your ankles, easily ignored. The right preparation matters.

memory_reward.title: Nettle Defense
memory_reward.description: Nettles sting through bare skin only. Covered clothing = safe passage. The stingers cannot penetrate fabric.

cue_tags.description: hairy-stemmed serrated plants blocking trail
